name.pt-BR: São Luís Maria Grignion de Montfort

patronOf.en-US: Apostle of true devotion to Mary
patronOf.pt-BR: Apóstolo da verdadeira devoção a Maria

prayerExcerpt.en-US: It is by Mary that the salvation of the world has begun, and it is by Mary that it must be consummated.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Foi por Maria que começou a salvação do mundo, e é por Maria que ela deve ser consumada.

meta.face: A tall, robust man of about forty, clean-shaven, with ruddy cheeks and a LONG face — a broad, high forehead, a strong aquiline nose, large, lively dark eyes lowered modestly, dark, straight brows, firm cheekbones, a wide, gentle mouth and a rather long chin; chestnut hair cut very short, lying flat and falling a little onto the top of the forehead; a look of grandeur and goodness together.
meta.basis: Besnard's early Life gives a portrait from those who knew him: above middle height, robust, ruddy cheeks, a long face, a broad high forehead, large lively but modest eyes, an aquiline nose, a rather long chin and very short, flat chestnut hair. Daniel records the crucifix and the small statue of Mary he always carried.
